analysis_steps.goal: Fit a rotating disk to the CO(2-1) cube

method.value: GalPaK3D disk model (exponential flux profile n=1, hyperbolic tangent rotation curve) convolved with PSF and LSF fit to the CO(2-1) channel cube; uncertainties from 100 simulated cubes with random noise seeds, combined in quadrature with systematic error

evidence.quote: We fit a disk model whose radial flux profile is exponential (Sérsic index $n=1$) and radial rotational velocity profile is hyperbolic tangent to the CO(2-1) channel map.

referee_caveats_inferred: The Summary says R21 = 1 (Milky Way value) while Section 4.1.1, Table 2 and the abstract use R21 = 2; the mass quoted depends on this assumption and the text is inconsistent
Gas mass relies on an assumed R21 = 2 and a metallicity-dependent alpha_CO from a single calibration; no CO(1-0) or dust-based cross-check of alpha_CO

R52 map uses CO(5-4) at 0.84 x 0.60 arcsec vs 4.8-6 kpc beams, so the UV-clump excitation peak (~0.3 arcsec offset) is a sub-beam feature; ALMA-HST astrometry is tied by assuming J125 peak = CO(2-1) peak
CO(5-4) data are only ~10 minutes on source (rms 0.91 mJy/beam), so R52 map S/N is limited
Stellar surface density uses a constant M/L and a single-component or fixed n=4/n=1 two-component decomposition, which drives the 'gas associated with bulge' conclusion
A single galaxy is studied, so generalising to main-sequence clumpy galaxies is not supported statistically

Moment-map velocity windows and primary-beam handling
simobserve inputs for the 100 simulated cubes
Definition of the systematic error added to GalPaK3D uncertainties
Whether the data are in the public ALMA archive (not stated by the paper)
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Two ALMA projects: Cycle 3 Band 3 12-m (4.7 h on source, 41 antennas) plus a short Cycle 0 Band 6 execution; roughly tens of GB of raw data, a few GB for calibrated cubes; HST CANDELS cutouts are small
reproducibility.score_reason: Both projects are named and a good part of the recipe is given (CASA versions, robust, channel width, GalPaK3D and GALFIT set-up, numeric tables), but imaging masks, line-free channels, fitting priors and the CO(5-4) calibration (in Seko16) are missing, and the R21 value is internally inconsistent
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA Cycle 0 and Cycle 3 data of named projects are normally in the public archive, the key results (fluxes, R52, GalPaK3D parameters, f_gas) are numeric, and the recipe is mostly complete, although the paper does not itself state public availability
